analysis: E1: repeated create calls in AppWorld's released baseline outputs

reconciliation.explanation: one failing run sent the payment-request create call once without an access token and again after it logged in; it holds two inserts and no identical pair

rule_definitions.A: the same target create call with the same payload, access token included, sent two or more times
rule_definitions.B: rule A with the access token removed from the payload
rule_definitions.C: two inserted payment-request rows equal after timestamps, identifiers and record hashes are dropped
